en: A black-and-white postcard depicting a dramatic rocky mountain landscape. Jagged peaks and volcanic rock formations dominate the scene. The upper right of the postcard features printed text in French, indicating the location as Mont-Dore, Le Sancy, specifically 'Les Cheminées du Diable' in the Puy-de-Dôme department. The overall visual style and print suggest an early 20th-century period.
